interpretation.prototype_similarity: Unvalidated ranking against four operator-reviewed kinematic prototypes; it is not a no-takeover probability or classifier accuracy.
interpretation.observed_braking_onset: First sustained -1 m/s2 response backtracked to -0.3 m/s2; it is not the unavailable ECU AEB request time.
interpretation.target_reference_actual: Synchronized object/head-tracker reference and actual position channels from the same exported Time rows; low-level actuator commands are separate.
